main_description: We've gathered answers to the most frequently asked questions. If you didn't find yours, message our support team.

questions.title: One subscription for all devices
questions.text: Your Uboost subscription is shared: it works in the Android, iOS, Android TV and PC apps and in the browser extension. Sign in with your email in the app or the extension — not as a guest or with an ID. If your subscription or trial is already active, it will appear on your other devices automatically as soon as you sign in with the same email. The trial is shared too and is given once per email.

questions.title: What is Uboost
questions.text: Uboost is a service for accessing YouTube and other blocked resources. There is an app for Android/iOS/Android TV, a desktop app and a browser extension. All versions share one subscription.

questions.title: How the Uboost versions differ
questions.text: Uboost for Android/iOS is an app for smartphones, tablets and Android TV. Uboost for PC is a full-featured desktop app. Uboost for browsers is an extension for Chrome and other browsers. One subscription covers all versions; plans differ by the number of devices.

questions.title: Which devices can I connect
questions.text: You can use Uboost on: smartphones and tablets (Android, iOS), TVs and TV boxes (Android TV), and computers (the desktop app or browser extension).

questions.title: Is the TV box still on sale
questions.text: Yes, of course — our TV box is available for purchase. You can buy it on our website [uboost.store](https://uboost.store), on [Ozon](https://ozon.ru/t/g2KbNcP) or Wildberries.

questions.title: What region is the VPN in
questions.text: The servers change constantly, so the connection region changes accordingly.

questions.title: How to install the app on Android
questions.text: Download the app from [ubst.app/download](https://ubst.app/download) — it has links to Google Play and the APK file. If you downloaded the APK, run it on your device.

questions.title: How to download the app on iPhone
questions.text: The app has been temporarily removed from the Russian App Store. To install it, change your App Store region to Kazakhstan: Settings → Apple ID → “Media & Purchases” → “View Account” → “Country/Region” → Kazakhstan, payment method “None”, city Almaty. Then install [Uboost from the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/kz/app/id6751346206) and sign in with your email. App updates also require the Kazakhstan region.

questions.title: How to download Uboost on a Smart TV
questions.text: IMPORTANT: The TV must run Android OS. Open Google Play on your TV, find Uboost and install the app. If that doesn't work, download the APK file from [ubst.app/download](https://ubst.app/download) — in the TV browser or on a computer, then install it from a USB drive. After installing, sign in with your email.

questions.title: How to install the app on a computer
questions.text: Download the Uboost app for Windows from [ubst.app/download](https://ubst.app/download), run the installer and sign in with your email. Follow the news about new releases in our [Telegram channel](https://telegram.me/uboostrussia).

questions.title: How to install the browser extension
questions.text: The Uboost extension can be installed for free from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/%D1%8E%D0%B1%D1%83%D1%81%D1%82-vpn-%D0%B4%D0%BB%D1%8F-youtube-%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%85/jddgbeighonaipjikdnfdpiefhoomlae). Sign in to the extension with your email so your subscription is shared with the apps. A full-featured desktop app is also available for PC.

questions.title: Is there a free version
questions.text: The apps have no free mode. New users get a trial: 2 days of Premium on 10 devices, once per email. The browser extension has a free mode for YouTube.

questions.title: How many devices are included in the subscription
questions.text: The number of devices depends on your plan. The limit is counted separately for the apps and for the extension: for example, a 5-device plan means up to 5 apps and up to 5 extensions. On each device, sign in with the email the subscription was purchased with.

questions.title: How to renew your plan
questions.text: Open the Uboost app, tap “Buy plan”, choose a payment method, and tap “Buy”. You can also renew your plan in your [personal account](https://uboost.site/profile) — sign in and tap “Go to payment details”. After a successful payment, your plan will be renewed automatically.

questions.title: I paid for a subscription on my phone — how do I use it on PC
questions.text: Install the desktop app or the browser extension and sign in with the same email you use on your phone. Your subscription will be connected automatically.

questions.title: Do the app and the extension work with one subscription
questions.text: Yes, the subscription is shared between the apps and the extension as long as you sign in with the same email everywhere. If you signed in to the extension as a guest or with an ID, the subscription works only there.

questions.title: How to find your ID
questions.text: The ID is used only in the Uboost browser extension. It's not needed for the mobile app or the desktop app — there you sign in with your email. If you have an extension subscription and need your ID, send us your payment receipt and we'll send it to you.

questions.title: I need an ID
questions.text: The ID is used in the Uboost browser extension if you signed in without an email. If you have an extension subscription, send us your payment receipt as a file and we'll send you your ID.

questions.title: I forgot my email
questions.text: Unfortunately, we can't tell you or recover your email, as we don't have access to this information. Please try to remember or check which addresses you might have used during registration.

questions.title: Please reset all devices on my account
questions.text: Please send us the email address the subscription was registered with.

questions.title: I changed the server, but nothing changed
questions.text: Follow these steps in order: 1) Check your connection type — does YouTube open over Wi-Fi? If it works over Wi-Fi but not over mobile data, your carrier uses “allow lists”. Connect to Wi-Fi or get “White Internet” in [our bot](https://telegram.me/uboostbel_bot). 2) Remove other VPN and proxy extensions on your device. 3) Open your device Settings, find the “DNS” section and set it to “Off”, then restart your device.

questions.title: YouTube isn't working
questions.text: To help solve the problem, please provide: 1) The email your subscription is registered with. 2) Technical information from the app — tap the “Support” button on the main screen and the data will be copied automatically. Paste it into your message and send it.

questions.title: Endless loading when connecting
questions.text: To help solve the problem, please provide: 1) The email your subscription is registered with. 2) Technical information from the app — tap the “Support” button on the main screen and the data will be copied automatically.

questions.title: The app disconnects on its own every 5 minutes
questions.text: To help solve the problem, please provide: 1) The email your subscription is registered with. 2) Technical information from the app — tap the “Support” button on the main screen and the data will be copied automatically.

questions.title: Why do I see ads with a paid subscription
questions.text: Ads can appear only in “All Internet” mode — that's how this mode works. If you see ads in “YouTube Only” mode, that's incorrect behavior. Let us know about it and include your email.

questions.title: The code isn't arriving in my email
questions.text: Check your “Spam” and “Promotions” folders, and search your email for the word “Uboost”. If there's still no email, send us the email address you registered your subscription with.

questions.title: I can't install the app on my Android phone
questions.text: To install, try using the APK file. Download it from [ubst.app/download](https://ubst.app/download) and run it on your device.
